theory: The equivalences are mathematically correct, but the introduction and procedure centre on mixed-unit representation, decimal-digit interpretation and comparison rather than the booklet's single-unit conversions. Align the teaching procedure with multiplying kilograms by 1000 to obtain grams and dividing grams by 1000 to obtain kilograms.

summary: Replaced the unsupported practice and quiz tasks with cited single-unit conversions, preserving the supported items exactly and checking every changed answer and distractor. Aligned the theory with multiplying or dividing by 1000, removed part (a) of the first worked example while retaining its supported grams-to-kilograms calculation, and removed the two unsupported whole worked examples.
reviewSummary: All 22 final items have correct answers, use supported booklet conversion types, and remain focused on kilograms and grams; every quiz has exactly one correct option with accurate distractor explanations.
